# Kyra Shelf Guard

> A Python university project for SKU-independent suspicious shelf-removal detection from replayable RGB-D scenarios. Person 1 owns data, deterministic simulation, calibration, baseline artifacts, dataset conversion, and provenance.

The controlling assignment wins over repository summaries. Current code is an early foundation: contracts, manifest, reader, foundation tests, baseline persistence, and MiDaS alignment exist, while the generator, golden pack, OCID converter, and CLI are still planned.

## Start Here

- [README](README.md): Human overview, current status, laptop feasibility, and documentation map.
- [Person 1 Specification](docs/PERSON1_SPEC.md): Requirement IDs, scope, interfaces, and acceptance criteria.
